question: Will it rain in Manila on Oct 26, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if a total precipitation of greater than 0.0 mm (0.00 in) is recorded in Manila, Philippines strictly after 2026-10-25T16:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-27T00:00:00Z.
- "No": Wins if the total precipitation recorded in Manila, Philippines during the same window is 0.0 mm (0.00 in) — i.e., no measurable rainfall is observed.

Clarifications:
- The measurement window spans strictly after 2026-10-25T16:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-27T00:00:00Z. Any measurable precipitation (above trace, > 0.00 in) recorded at the Manila reference station during this window satisfies the "Yes" condition.
- "Manila" refers to Manila, Philippines (Metro Manila area), not any other location of the same name. The primary reference station is Ninoy Aquino International Airport (IATA: MNL, ICAO: RPLL).
